ITEM 1 | Pale green cubed melon, pieces about 2-2.5 cm, firm edges with slightly translucent light-green flesh, arranged in a loose cluster on the left side of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Yellow-orange cubed fruit, pieces about 1.5-2 cm, moist glossy surfaces with some lighter edges, sitting among the melon cubes near the top left | 50
ITEM 3 | Bright red cubed watermelon, pieces about 2 cm, juicy with slightly glossy surfaces and pale edges, scattered along the lower left of the plate | 130
ITEM 4 | Pale yellow scrambled eggs, soft clumped curds with some fluffy folds and a matte surface, spread across the upper right area of the plate | 110
ITEM 5 | Crisp-looking cooked bacon strips, golden-brown to dark amber with glossy rendered fat sheen and charred edges, several overlapping strips across the lower right | 45
ITEM 6 | Rendered bacon fat or glaze, glossy amber residue pooled on and between the bacon strips and fruit at the lower center | 8
